description: Verify that Wopee.io is connected: returns the project name and UUID, app URL, plan, steps left, reset time and the Commander link for the project of WOPEE_API_KEY, and names the problem when the key belongs to another project than WOPEE_PROJECT_UUID, the UUID is missing or the key is rejected. Read-only, takes no input. Call it as the last step of a setup and whenever a tool answers Not Authorised!.
name: wopee_setup_check
title: Check the setup
